values: 召唤法阵，点亮后会给周围敌我双方施加效果。所有法阵均被点亮时施放全场法阵。
Velara summons magic circles that can be awakened to affect nearby allies and enemies. Once all magic circles are awakened, their effects extend across the entire battlefield.

战斗开始时，奎茵在战场上召唤4个法阵，每个法阵累计获得1000能量后会被点亮。法阵被点亮后，使周围2格内所有友军每秒回复奎茵40% + 8% ATK的生命值、所有敌军降低30 + 5点急速。
主动释放时，奎茵消耗自身的能量给目标法阵充能直到它被点亮。若所有法阵均被点亮，将法阵的影响范围扩大到全场，同时降低全场敌人30% + 3%的基础属性并将其平均转移给我方角色，持续10秒；每名我方角色获得的转移属性上限为奎茵对应初始属性的45%（在挑战首领的模式中，改为固定达到该上限）。

Passive. When a battle starts, Velara summons 4 dormant magic circles on the battlefield. Each circle awakens after accumulating 1000 Energy. When a circle awakens, it affects all units within 2 tiles, restoring 40% + 8% ATK HP to allies and reducing enemies' Haste by 30 + 5.
Active. Velara channels her Energy into one of her dormant circles until it awakens. If all circles are already awakened, she instead expands their area of effect to cover the entire battlefield and transfers 30% + 3% of basic stats from all enemies, then evenly distributing them among all allied units, lasting for 10s. The transferred stats that each ally receives cannot exceed 45% of Velara's starting stats. In boss fights, allies will always receive the maximum amount of transferred stats.
法阵被点亮后，友军每秒回复的生命值提升至奎茵50% + 8% ATK、敌军降低的急速提升至35 + 5点。
Awakened magic circle restores 50% + 8% ATK HP to allies and reduces enemies' Haste by 35 + 5.
法阵被点亮后，友军每秒回复的生命值提升至奎茵60% + 8% ATK、敌军降低的急速提升至40 + 5点。
Awakened magic circle restores 60% + 8% ATK HP to allies and reduces enemies' Haste by 40 + 5.
法阵被点亮后，友军每秒回复的生命值提升至奎茵70% + 8% ATK、敌军降低的急速提升至45 + 5点。
Awakened magic circle restores 70% + 8% ATK HP to allies and reduces enemies' Haste by 45 + 5.
法阵被点亮后，友军每秒回复的生命值提升至奎茵80% + 8% ATK、敌军降低的急速提升至50 + 5点。
Awakened magic circle restores 80% + 8% ATK HP to allies and reduces enemies' Haste by 50 + 5.
定身输出最高的敌人并降低其属性。
Velara immobilizes the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt and reduces their stats.
将此时累计输出最高的敌人定身，并降低目标50 + 10点急速、45% + 6%护甲和魔抗，持续5秒。场上每存在1个已点亮的法阵，持续时间延长0.5秒。

Velara immobilizes the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, reducing their Haste by 50 + 10 and their Phys & Magic DEF by 45% + 6% for 5s. Each awakened magic circle extends this duration by 0.5s.
降低的急速提升至55 + 10点，降低的护甲和魔抗提升至50% + 6%。
Increases the Haste reduction to 55 + 10, and Phys & Magic DEF reduction to 50% + 6%.
降低的急速提升至60 + 10点，降低的护甲和魔抗提升至55% + 6%。
Increases the Haste reduction to 60 + 10, and Phys & Magic DEF reduction to 55% + 6%.
降低的急速提升至70 + 10点，降低的护甲和魔抗提升至60% + 6%。
Increases the Haste reduction to 70 + 10, and Phys & Magic DEF reduction to 60% + 6%.
战斗开始时点亮一个法阵。法阵会不断通过敌人的属性降低效果充能。
Velara awakens a magic circle when a battle starts. Magic circles gain Energy from nearby enemies affected by stat reduction debuffs.

战斗开始时，若奎茵站在法阵上，则点亮脚下的法阵，否则点亮距离自身布阵位置最远的法阵。
被动地，所有法阵每3秒根据2格内的敌人拥有属性降低效果的数量充能，每有1个来自不同友军的属性降低效果，法阵回复24 + 4点能量。

If Velara is placed within a magic circle when a battle starts, that circle is immediately awakened. Otherwise, the circle farthest from her position is awakened instead.
Passive. Every 3s, each magic circle gains Energy based on the stat reduction debuffs on enemies within 2 tiles. For each unique ally who inflicted any of those debuffs, the circle gains 24 + 4 Energy.
法阵每次回复的能量提升至26 + 4。
Increases the Energy gained from each debuff to 26 + 4.
法阵每次回复的能量提升至28 + 4。
Increases the Energy gained from each debuff to 28 + 4.
法阵每次回复的能量提升至32 + 4。
Increases the Energy gained from each debuff to 32 + 4.
提高自身急速，所有法阵均被点亮后额外提高急速。
Velara increases her Haste, with an extra boost when all magic circles are awakened.
战斗中，自身提高12点急速，所有法阵均被点亮后额外提高3点急速。
Velara increases her Haste by 12 during battle. When all her magic circles are awakened, her Haste is increased by an extra 3.
战斗中，自身提高15点急速，所有法阵均被点亮后额外提高4点急速。
Velara increases her Haste by 15 during battle. When all her magic circles are awakened, her Haste is increased by an extra 4.
战斗中，自身提高18点急速，所有法阵均被点亮后额外提高5点急速。
Velara increases her Haste by 18 during battle. When all her magic circles are awakened, her Haste is increased by an extra 5.
法阵被点亮后对最虚弱的单位施加效果。
Awakened magic circles periodically apply effects to the weakest units.

法阵被点亮后，选择其2格范围内最虚弱的单位发射波纹，若目标为友方，则使其获得奎茵500% ATK的护盾，持续8秒，否则对其造成奎茵300% ATK的伤害。
每有1个已点亮的法阵，额外使此技能施加的护盾和伤害效果增强10%。

When a magic circle awakens, it fires a mystic bolt to the weakest unit within 2 tiles. If the unit is an ally, they gain a 500% ATK shield for 8s; if it's an enemy, they take 300% ATK damage.
Each awakened magic circle increases the shield value applied or damage dealt by this skill by 10%.
“恩典裁决”使友方获得的护盾值提升至奎茵550% ATK、敌方受到的伤害提升至350%。
Increases the shield value granted by Graceful Edict to 550% ATK and the damage it deals to 350%.
战斗中每10秒，所有已点亮的法阵对场上最虚弱的单位再次发射波纹。
Every 10s during battle, each awakened magic circle fires a mystic bolt at the weakest unit on the battlefield.
“恩典裁决”使友方获得的护盾值提升至奎茵600% ATK、敌方受到的伤害提升至400%。
Increases the shield value granted by Graceful Edict to 600% ATK and the damage it deals to 400%.
使"无赦秘仪"施放的全场法阵持续到战斗结束，每次施放额外使友方获得霸体和伤害提高。
After all magic circles are awakened, Ruthless Rite causes them to cover the entire battlefield until the battle ends. Each subsequent cast makes allies unaffected and increases their damage.
当所有法阵均被点亮后，使"无赦秘仪"将法阵范围扩大到全场的效果持续到战斗结束，且后续施放时使所有友方单位进入霸体状态，且造成伤害提高5%，持续5秒。

After all magic circles are awakened, casting Ruthless Rite expands their area of effect to cover the entire battlefield until the battle ends. Each subsequent cast makes allied units unaffected and increases their damage dealt by 5% for 5s.
